references.text: Caleb, who followed the Lord wholeheartedly, is promised the land he had spied out. This is the parallel account in Numbers.
Caleb and Joshua are the only ones from that generation allowed to enter the Promised Land because they followed the Lord faithfully.
Caleb son of Jephunneh is mentioned as one who followed the Lord wholeheartedly and therefore receives an inheritance in the land.
The fulfillment of the promise to Caleb. He receives Hebron as his inheritance because he followed the Lord, the God of Israel, wholeheartedly.
Caleb receives his inheritance in Judah, just as the Lord had promised through Moses.
Caleb son of Jephunneh is presented as one of the twelve spies sent to explore the land of Canaan.
Caleb showed faith and courage by encouraging the people to go up and take possession of the land, unlike the other spies.
